title: Word Embeddings in PyTorch
learning_objectives: Map tokens to integer ids with a vocabulary that has an unknown token
Average learned word embeddings with nn.EmbeddingBag and offsets
Train an embedding-bag classifier end to end
entry_point: build_vocab(texts, min_count=1); encode(texts, vocab); class BagClassifier(nn.Module); train_bag(texts, labels, dim=16, epochs=30, lr=0.05, seed=0)
hints: Vocabulary: `Counter` over all words, keep those with enough counts, sort by `(-count, word)`, and number from 1.
Encode: extend one list of ids per text, recording `len(ids)` before each text as its offset.
Training: one forward pass on all texts per epoch — `loss = loss_fn(model(ids, offsets), y)`.

failure_feedback.advice: Reserve 0 for <unk>, then number words by (-count, word).
Offsets are start positions; unknown words map to 0.
Use nn.EmbeddingBag(vocab_size, dim, mode='mean') followed by nn.Linear.
Seed before creating the model and finish in eval() mode.
